# Heart to Heart Enrichment Center

> Heart to Heart Enrichment Center is a licensed child care center in Cleveland, Ohio. It offers childcare for infants, toddlers, preschool and school-age children, with free meals, free school transportation, homework assistance, toddler potty training support, and family support including help understanding public benefits.

## Business facts

- Name: Heart to Heart Enrichment Center
- Website: https://hearts25.com/
- Address: 3095 W. 25th Street, Cleveland, OH 44113
- Phone: (216) 938-6771
- Ohio child care center license number: 000000300622
- Ohio Step Up To Quality — Bronze Rated. Step Up To Quality is Ohio's quality rating and improvement system for early care and education programs.
- Continuous Ohio child care center license issued September 11, 2014 by the Ohio Department of Children and Youth.
- Official provider record (license and Bronze rating): https://childcaresearch.ohio.gov/provider/300622/
- Verify the license: https://childcaresearch.ohio.gov/
- Hours: 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Languages of the website: English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Swahili (the website only; this does not describe staff language ability)

## Services and costs

- Accepts families participating in Ohio's Publicly Funded Child Care (PFCC) program.
- Free childcare tuition for eligible families who receive full PFCC coverage. Eligibility, authorized coverage and any copay are determined by Ohio's PFCC program and the county agency.
- No application fee.
- No registration fee for PFCC families.
- Free meals for children in care.
- Free school transportation with pickup within 10 miles of the center, subject to school and route availability.
- Wraparound services: individualized support for families and connections to community resources.
- Help understanding public benefits and childcare benefit applications. Heart to Heart is not a government agency or benefits advisor; outside agencies decide eligibility.
- Homework time and homework assistance for school-age children.
- Potty training support for toddlers, in partnership with parents.
- Multicultural, welcoming community.

- The center is licensed by the State of Ohio as a child care center. Verify the current license status and inspection information at Ohio Child Care Search: https://childcaresearch.ohio.gov/
